relationships.reason: The resource mirrors the prefix/subcategory order used by WAGRRuntimeClassifier so the runtime browser can keep a stable visual taxonomy even as selector inventory changes.
WAAB selectors are grouped by their own key prefix first, then by negative/positive/debug subcategory, instead of collapsing under the broad WAABProperties owner class.
WAServerProperties exposes userContext/setUserContext/configureUserContext and isInternalUser; WAContextMain exists only in main executable.
SharedModules has WAContext/container classes; main executable has WAContextMain concrete graph with many managers/services.
FOAWAABPropertiesImpl exposes boolForKey/stringForKey/integer accessors and wraps AB properties.
WAFoaAppUtilities exposes installed-state class properties for Facebook/Instagram/Threads/MetaAI.
WABiz.BizManager contains an abProperties ivar; many WABiz surfaces are server/AB gated.
OnlinePresenceDotView is UI only; actual gates are likely WAAB/WAContextMain services.

runtime_taxonomy_policy.startup_policy: No runtime scan at startup; scan only when the menu opens and install hooks only for explicit toggles.

backup_import_policy.export_scope: NSUserDefaults keys owned by WATweaks only: wagr*, WAGR*, wa_*, selected WA legacy keys already used by the tweak
backup_import_policy.import_policy: mirror: apply all JSON preferences and remove existing WATweaks keys absent from the imported JSON
backup_import_policy.reason: runtime inventory maps feature groups; backup stores user choices, not raw binary state
